chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Yaqteeni, from Ubaydullah al-Dahqan, from Durust, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

key_terms.الْبَرَصَ: Vitiligo (a skin disease causing loss of color in patches)

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of eating when already full according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the physical ailment of vitiligo (baras) to the specific habit of eating beyond satiety, reflecting the Shia tradition of viewing dietary moderation as a key to both physical and spiritual health. This teaching is situated within the broader Islamic medical ethos that considers overeating a root cause of various diseases, emphasizing that the stomach is the house of disease. It serves as a practical guideline for believers to maintain bodily purity and prevent illness through mindful consumption.
